import sys

def positive(x):
    return x if x > 0 else 0

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    nums = list(map(int, data))
    # n = nums[0]  # not used
    a = [nums[1], nums[2], nums[3]]
    b = [nums[4], nums[5], nums[6]]

    min_val = positive(a[0] - b[0] - b[2]) + positive(a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) + positive(a[2] - b[1] - b[2])
    max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])

    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_val} {max_val}\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
